Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself, so messages keep coming while Telegram is closed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. A second switch, Mention by ID, turns @ and a user ID typed in the message box into a real mention of people the app has already seen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. A second switch gives voice messages next and previous in the notification, on the lock screen and on headphones. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_removed.name: Unlock Premium features
patches_removed.description: Makes Telegram on your phone treat your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks behind Premium open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits, like upload size, stay the same. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches_modified.description: Forwards new messages others send in one chat to another by rules you set, every message or only messages with media. A forward from any account you're signed in to is never forwarded again, so rules can't loop, and at most 20 go out a minute. Starts off. Turn it on and add rules in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Bot token sign-in
patches_modified.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches_modified.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them, and offers a channel that banned you on the web. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Bypass integrity check
patches_modified.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. A second switch, Keep downloaded stickers, keeps sticker files out of Telegram's automatic cache cleanup, so packs you've used don't download again. A Sticker panel size row shows fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and its search. All three start off. Change them in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Chat preview buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat you press and hold, so the preview opens fully or goes away with one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads

A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Folders by chat type
patches_modified.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. patches_modified.name: Free proxies

Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups

patches_modified.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches_modified.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches_modified.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches_modified.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep captions with their photos
patches_modified.description: When you remove or reorder photos that each have a caption in the attach menu, every caption stays with its own photo instead of moving to the new first photo. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys

patches_modified.name: Lyrics and song dates
patches_modified.description: Adds Lyrics to the music player's menu, found on lrclib.net and scrolling along with the song, and shows when you added each song to your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: My messages
patches_modified.description: Adds My messages to a group's menu at the top, which searches the group for the messages you sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Never send an uncropped photo
patches_modified.description: When Telegram can't finish cropping a photo, keeps the editor open and asks you to try again instead of sending the photo uncropped. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.description: Keeps Proxy in the chat list's menu, which Telegram only shows while a proxy is on or where Telegram is blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. A second switch gives voice messages next and previous in the notification, on the lock screen and on headphones. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Best video quality
patches_added.description: Plays videos at the largest size Pinterest has instead of capping them, the way Pinterest already does for some accounts. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Board order when saving
patches_added.description: Lists your boards in the Save to sheet in the order your profile shows them, a custom order included, instead of A to Z. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Custom font
patches_added.description: Shows Pinterest's text in a font file you pick, a .ttf or .otf. Icons keep their own look. Starts off. Pick the file with Font file in HushPinterest settings > Interface, which turns the switch on for you, then restart Pinterest.

patches_added.name: Full-size profile photos
patches_added.description: Opens someone's profile photo full size when you tap it on their profile, the way Pinterest already does for some accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Like and comment history
patches_added.description: Keeps a list on your phone of the pins you like and the comments and replies you post. Find it under Your likes and comments in HushPinterest settings > Privacy, where you can show only likes or only comments and tap one to open its pin. Unliking a pin takes it off the list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_added.name: Pin video playback
patches_added.description: Lets a video on a pin you open or swipe to wait for you to tap play, and start with the sound off. Two switches, both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Pinch to zoom only
patches_added.description: Pinching a pin's picture opens it full screen to zoom and drag, instead of loading pins that look like it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Swipe down to close pins
patches_added.description: Lets you close a pin you opened by pulling it down, a gesture Pinterest has built but only gives some accounts. Back and the back arrow work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Dark search bar and Follow button
patches_added.description: Adds switches that turn Explore's white search bar and the white Follow button at the top of a blog dark, and one that takes the Search Tumblr label off the bar. They start off. Turn them on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_added.name: Fix hard-to-read text
patches_added.description: Fits the related tags under a trending topic at bigger text sizes, where Tumblr cuts them in half, and shades the box you type in when you search a blog so the words show over a bright header. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide More posts like this
patches_added.description: Takes the "More posts like this" grid out from under a post you open, along with its heading. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_added.name: Hide followed blogs in For you
patches_added.description: Takes posts from blogs you follow out of the For you tab as each page loads. Following and the rest of Tumblr still show them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_added.name: More images per post
patches_added.description: Lets you add up to 30 images to a post, as Tumblr's website does, instead of 10. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_added.name: Text size
patches_added.description: Makes Tumblr's text bigger or smaller than your phone's font size, from 85% to 130%. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a size in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: App font
patches_modified.description: Replaces Tumblr's own font with your phone's font, or a font file you choose in settings. Fonts a post's author picked stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Collapse long posts
patches_modified.description: Cuts long posts in your timelines to about a screen, with Tumblr's own Read more row under them. Tap it and the whole post opens right there in the timeline. A long entry in a reblog trail gets cut the same way, and its Read more opens the post. Asks keep Tumblr's layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts, where the cut can be as short as about 5 lines or as long as two screens.

Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts, where you can make the cut half a screen or two screens instead.

patches_modified.name: Dark background color
patches_modified.description: Makes the background of Tumblr's Dark Mode palette black, which can save battery on OLED screens, or another dark color you pick when patching. On Android 12 or newer it can follow your wallpaper's colors instead. Blog and tag pages take it too, in place of their own colors. Other palettes stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Turns off Firebase and Google's analytics collection, and Tumblr's own tracking and ad measurement once it restarts. LiveRamp's identity tracker doesn't start when Tumblr launches, and Crashlytics crash reports stay off while the switch is on. The Firebase and Google analytics part stays until you patch again without it. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Tumblr asking Google Play for a newer version and showing Play's update prompt. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Filter activity notifications
patches_modified.description: Hides selected likes, reblogs, replies, follows, mentions, asks and boops from the activity list as pages load. Each switch starts off. Choose them in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Fit full-screen videos
patches_modified.description: Shows tall videos whole in the full-screen player, instead of filling the screen's height and cutting off the sides. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Firebase can refuse a patched Tumblr whose request doesn't name Tumblr's original signature, so this sends its fingerprint. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide Blaze prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides the prompts to pay for Blaze, Tumblr's way to promote a post. That covers the Blaze buttons on your blog and dashboard, the nudge after you post, the Blaze banners, and the Blaze buttons on posts: the flame under your own posts, Blaze in a post's menu and the share sheet, and Promote in community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Featured posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the staff-picked posts Tumblr shows under a Featured header out of your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Tumblr TV
patches_modified.description: Takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom bar, and stops sign-up from sending you there. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Watch it rows
patches_modified.description: Takes Tumblr TV's Watch it rows and video hub cards out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Takes ad cards and paid Blaze posts out of your dashboard and other feeds. Sponsored banners go too, along with the one-line app promos (Made with WordPress and its Install button) on tag pages and in search. A sponsored header at the top of Explore stays empty. Tumblr stops asking its ad networks for more and stops showing a full-screen ad when you open a blog, and the ad networks don't start when Tumblr launches. Its Keep Blaze posts option leaves the Blaze posts in. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Tumblr and the ad companies inside it see an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you'd deleted your ad ID in Android. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide blog notification reminders
patches_modified.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you turn on notifications for a blog. Your subscriptions and notification settings stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide filtered posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the posts Tumblr covers with "This post contains filtered content" out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds, so your filtered tags and words hide them completely. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide gift purchase popups
patches_modified.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you buy a gift for a blog. You can still open gifting yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide hashtags
patches_modified.description: Takes the tags off the bottom of posts in your dashboard, other feeds and Tumblr TV, and keeps the source link. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide liked posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the posts you've already liked out of your dashboard as each page loads. Your likes and the rest of Tumblr still show them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide note counts
patches_modified.description: Takes the like, reblog and comment counts off the footer under posts, community posts included, and the counts off a post's notes, from the top and its tabs to each comment's likes and replies. The buttons stay and still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide photo posts
patches_modified.description: Takes photo posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with pictures and no video, its reblog trail included, counts as a photo post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts with these words
patches_modified.description: Hides posts matching your word list. Choose whether to check current text, the reblog trail, tags or summaries. Allowed words can keep a matching post, but other enabled filters still apply. Both word editors let you type a made-up post and see what the word filter would do with it. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide reblogs
patches_modified.description: Takes reblogs out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads, and keeps the posts people made themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide reblogs of your posts
patches_modified.description: Takes other people's reblogs of your posts out of your dashboard as each page loads. Your blog and the rest of Tumblr still show them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested blogs
patches_modified.description: Takes the blogs Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, whether as cards, rows or carousels, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested communities

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested tags

patches_modified.name: Hide text posts
patches_modified.description: Takes text posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with no pictures or video, its reblog trail included, counts as a text post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Communities tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Communities tab out of the bottom bar and stops the Communities tips in the post editor. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Explore and search button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Follow button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow button out of the header of posts from blogs you don't follow yet. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notifications button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Save button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Save button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, when Tumblr shows one. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the ad-free banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the banner on your dashboard that asks you to pay for Ad-Free Browsing. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the comment button
patches_modified.description: Takes the comment button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the diamond and TumblrMart
patches_modified.description: Hides the Premium diamond and the TumblrMart button at the top of your dashboard, Explore and notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the like button
patches_modified.description: Takes the like button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, and the reactions off community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the reblog button
patches_modified.description: Takes the reblog button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the share button

patches_modified.name: Hide unread dots

patches_modified.name: Hide video posts

patches_modified.name: Hide your own reblogs

patches_modified.name: HushTumblr settings

patches_modified.name: Line between posts
patches_modified.description: Draws a thin line in the gap between posts, so it's easier to see where one ends and the next begins. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Mute posts locally
patches_modified.description: Adds a local mute action to post menus. Originals and their reblogs stay hidden for this account. On the dashboard the menu can also hide one blog's reblogs or its originals. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Tumblr, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Reorder the bottom bar
patches_modified.description: Puts the bottom bar's tabs in an order you pick, from a list in its settings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Reveal allowed mature content
patches_modified.description: Removes mature-content covers only when Tumblr explicitly allows them for the signed-in adult account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Links you share or copy from Tumblr leave out the ?source=share tag Tumblr adds to them, and still open the same post or blog. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Share video links
patches_modified.description: Long-press a video in a post to share or copy its direct link, or save the video to your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Sharper images

patches_modified.name: Show mutual markers
patches_modified.description: Marks blogs that follow your primary blog when you follow them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Show post timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows when posts were made using Tumblr's own timestamp layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Skip review prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up that asks what you think of the Tumblr app and then asks you for a store rating or feedback. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in

patches_modified.name: Tags open the blog's tag search

patches_modified.name: Tap to play feed videos

patches_modified.name: Turn off screenshot sharing

patches_modified.name: Visible image descriptions

patches_added.name: Dark search bar and Follow button

patches_added.name: Fix hard-to-read text

patches_added.name: Hide More posts like this

patches_added.name: Custom font
patches_added.description: Shows Threads' text in a font file you pick, a .ttf or .otf. Icons keep their own font. Starts off. Turn it on and pick the file in HushThreads settings > Appearance, then restart Threads.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Swaps the Threads icon on your home screen for the HushThreads logo, with a one-color version for themed icons, so a patched copy is easy to spot. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide post buttons
patches_added.description: Takes the like, reply, repost, share and save buttons off posts and replies, each on its own switch. A hidden button's count goes with it. Good if you keep tapping one by mistake. Every button starts out showing. Pick the ones to hide in HushThreads settings > Posts.

patches_added.name: HushThreads header logo
patches_added.description: Shows the HushThreads logo at the top of your feed instead of the Threads logo. It stays still while the feed refreshes, where Threads' logo spins. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in your feed when you leave Threads and come back within ten minutes. Pulling down to refresh still loads new posts. Good if you hate losing the post you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name under the app's icon, so a copy you install beside Threads with Change package name is easy to tell apart. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Gives the patched Threads its own package name, so it installs beside the Threads you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Raises the version number as high as Android allows, so Google Play won't offer Meta's updates over it. Going back to stock Threads means uninstalling, which deletes its data. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable swipe to Search
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on your feed from sliding into Search. The Search button still opens Search. Threads only has the swipe on some accounts. Good if you keep landing in Search while you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Filter comments
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the replies to a post that match words or domains you list, such as the shop link a spam reply ends with, before Threads shows them. A second switch under it also hides any reply with a web link. The replies that stay keep their order. Starts off. Turn it on and add your list in HushThreads settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Full size profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Opens a profile picture full size when you tap it on a profile, so you can zoom in and save it, instead of Threads' small circle. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed and from under the posts you open before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested users
patches_modified.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, the Follow suggestions row in Search and the suggested threads under a post you open. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so do a post's replies and the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its three switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: HushThreads settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in. Each way in has its own switch under Pause, backup and diagnostics, and the last one that's on stays on.

patches_modified.name: Max image quality
patches_modified.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Open links in browser
patches_modified.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Remove share targets
patches_modified.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key, and makes the share sheet's tiles open patched Meta apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Threads, and turns short share links into the post's own link. The link still opens the same post. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save photos and videos
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to a post's menu, below Copy link. It saves the photo or video to your gallery, every page of a carousel too, and on a text post it saves the video that post links or quotes. Good for keeping posts you like. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Show exact post times
patches_modified.description: Posts and replies show the date and time they went up instead of 3h or 2d, in your phone's 12 or 24-hour format. Good if you want to know exactly when something was posted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Spoof SIM region
patches_modified.description: Threads sees a SIM and network from a country you pick, with one of that country's real carriers, instead of your own. Meta can still go by your connection and your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Trust user-added certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets Threads accept security certificates you installed yourself, such as for a work network or a debugging proxy. Meta's own checks stay, so a proxy can't read most traffic. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches_modified.description: Optionally restricts the home feed to accounts you follow, by rewriting the feed request's pagination header. Gated on the runtime toggle.

patches_modified.name: Network content blocking
patches_modified.description: Blocks the feed, stories, explore, reels, ads, suggestions and tracking at the network layer, gated on the runtime toggles.

patches_modified.name: Notes tray
patches_modified.description: Lets the Notes block take the Notes tray out of the Direct inbox's list, for the accounts where Instagram draws it with Compose and no view id to hide.

patches_modified.name: Oxbow icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces the launcher icon with the Oxbow mark (adaptive, with a monochrome layer for themed icons).

patches_modified.name: Popup hiding
patches_modified.description: Drops Instagram's popups ("Couldn't refresh feed"), which a blocked surface raises on every failed request. Gated on the Instagram popups toggle.

patches_modified.name: Preserve post caption
patches_modified.description: Saves caption edits directly to the current post draft before opening music or story options.

patches_modified.name: Restart relay
patches_modified.description: Declares the one-shot activity Oxbow runs in its own process to bring Instagram back after the cache-clear restart.

patches_modified.name: Settings entry point
patches_modified.description: Opens the Oxbow settings on a long-press of the Home tab, and installs the surface hiders and update check.

patches_modified.name: Signature check bypass
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's two signing-certificate trust checks answer yes for this APK's own certificate, so a re-signed build is treated as an official Meta build and deep links route to their content. Every other certificate gets Instagram's own answer, so other apps are still checked.
patches_modified.previous_description: Forces Instagram's signing-certificate trust checks to always pass, so a re-signed APK is treated as an official Meta build and deep links route to their content instead of falling back to the home feed.

patches_modified.name: Suggested accounts in the story tray
patches_modified.description: Drops the suggested accounts Instagram mixes into the story tray, gated on the Suggested accounts toggle.

patches_added.name: List search and tap to top
patches_added.description: Adds a search bar above the History and Favorites lists, on your profile and in My list, that finds a title anywhere in them, and tapping the tab you're already on takes its list back to the top. On by default. Turn either off in HushPine settings.
